newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks trickled lower in early morning trade on Thursday, following the U.S. markets which ended a bit weaker overnight, brokers said.
They added that losses in the Tokyo market were not likely to be huge, as there was both technical support and investor interest near the 21,000 level in the key Nikkei average.
At 0013 GMT, the cash market's Nikkei 225 average was down 120.17 points or 0.57 percent at 21,036.58. In the futures market, its December futures were down 120 points at 21,080.
"The yen is a bit stronger today and the Dow was a bit weaker so Tokyo markets may soften," a broker at one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages said.
"But the 200-day moving average is pegged at the 20,980 level and that should provide a firm floor," he added.
